title: Reading Drill — Keeping a Foreshore Path Open
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Keeping a Foreshore Path Open
passages.body:
**A** A council tested a narrow path along the shore where sections were sometimes covered by the tide. Before starting repairs, it marked sections that already had an alternative inland route.

**B** At the lowest spot, adding a small raised deck looked promising but made it harder for maintenance staff to remove driftwood. The plan was changed to include a removable panel.

**C** The final map showed when the route might be closed and where to turn back. It did not give a guaranteed opening time because storm conditions could change water levels unexpectedly.

questions.prompt: Before starting repairs, it marked sections that already had an alternative ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Before starting repairs, it marked sections that already had an alternative inland route.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: At the lowest spot, adding a small raised deck looked promising but made it harder for maintenance staff to remove driftwood.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: It did not give a guaranteed opening time because storm conditions could change water levels unexpectedly.
